master.note: Leader time-shared exchange (STREAM_MODE_POLLED + LEADER_EXCHANGE 0x5E): the leader queues uplink records and only answers, so host and leader never transmit at the same time -- an uplink frame being sent while a host byte arrives loses the bytes in flight. Verified on the taccap-collector backpack (0029m/0030m): 0 bad uplink frames under full host load with ~20 Hz LED commands vs 17/7208 pushing on 1.2.6. HOST-BREAKING: IMU/encoder timestamp is now TIM2 1 MHz (low 32 bits, wraps every 71 min 35 s), no longer DWT/250 (17.18 s); upgrade host software together. Known: after a power-up the leader can stop answering ~0.5 s after the first stream start until the port is reopened (also on 1.2.6). AFTER FLASHING, unplug and replug the leader's USB cable.

slave.note: Follower time-shared exchange (SLAVE_EXCHANGE 0x5D, queue 32), optional 1-100 Hz IMU with accel/gyro calibration and magnetometer sessions, uplink collision detect-and-resend, cold-start homing order fix. HOST-BREAKING: IMU timestamp is now TIM2 1 MHz (wraps every 71 min 35 s). Carries 1.2.16. AFTER FLASHING, unplug the 24 V power cable for ~2 s and plug it back; the USB cable can stay in.

EL05.note: RobStride EL05 motor firmware, flashed with motor_ota_update.py through the follower (follower firmware >= 1.2.8). Fixes the constant velocity feedback of 1.0.5.0.2. The motor itself answers the version as bytes 10.5.0.4; the vendor writes it 1.0.5.0.4. Keep the filename: the script reads the model and version from it.
